top_categories.workout_context: MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic's Gravel roads, Forest tracks forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 71 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
65ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on high country gravel and forest tracks, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
71 miles on high country gravel and forest tracks burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on high country gravel and forest tracks demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on high country gravel and forest tracks. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Base fitness for MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work for 4,600ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic’s 71 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at MAAP Beechworth Granite Classic requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on high country gravel and forest tracks to build confidence. Expect: gravel roads, forest tracks, high country terrain.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 71 miles of high country gravel and forest tracks in Beechworth, Victoria.
